expectation: Membrane ring on myeloid cells (monocytes, macrophages, MDSCs, some DCs). These cells are fairly common in tumour stroma. They should appear as scattered single cells or loose clusters in the stroma and at the tumour edge, not across tumour nests.
observed: A: broad yellow haze over whole tissue regions that varies image to image; in the D image, large sheets fill whole compartments. B: sparse yellow grain and a few small spots. C: faint even grain. D: a continuous yellow sheet between nuclei, with no discrete rings.
why: The signal follows tissue regions and per-image intensity, not a distinct set of ring-stained myeloid cells; the few bright spots are not enough to show a population.
notes: CD33 shows as haze and sheets over whole tissue areas that change brightness from image to image, with even grain in the typical fields. I found no clear set of separate membrane-ringed myeloid cells.
